description: Election Commission -  Elected D.P.A.P. Gunathilaka as vice Chairman of the Kurunegala P.S
reasoning: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the procedural steps following a resignation and the nomination of a new office holder by a political party, as declared by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under the definition of **Elections Gazettes (Type 7)**, which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections and offices.
